All-Hands Bot: All-hands live now! Drop your reactions + snack battlefield updates here :tada:
Maya: oven update — brought in leftover sourdough, 375F for 8 min :bread: :eyes:
Devon: wait the office oven is a mythical creature. did you preheat? :sweat_smile:
Maya: preheated 12m ago, engineer-verified (read: eyeballed)
Sam: officially casting votes: team sourdough vs bagels. I'm sourdough all the way :raised_hands:
Luca: bagel person here. sesame > everything
Anya: can we have a side poll? butter vs cream cheese? :thinking_face:
Chris: cream cheese, for the love of all that is holy :heart_eyes:
Allison: butter but light spread pls
Devon: also, if anyone's in SF office, can you grab an extra tray? I'll Venmo for toppings :money_with_wings:
Maya: @Devon put it on the fridge whiteboard I'll handle pickup after all-hands
OpsBot: Reminder: meeting recording will be available in #all-hands within 1 hour :pager:
Sam: applause for the infra update, btw. amazing latency numbers :clap::clap:
Luca: mic drop gif: <https://giphy.com/gifs/mic-drop|mic-drop>
Anya: Chef's table photo incoming :camera_with_flash:
Maya: quick timer set: `12:00` (counting down) — anyone want garlic butter? :garlic:
Chris: if garlic butter is attempted, I will write a haiku about it
Allison: please do
Chris: garlic butter haiku:
Chris: "Golden bubbles sing
A crust remembers summer
We crown the meeting"
Sam: :rofl: that's award-winning
All-Hands Bot: :tada: Best non-work haiku award goes to Chris :trophy:
Devon: poll results so far: sourdough 4, bagel 3, undecided 2 — keep voting with reactions :ballot_box_with_ballot:
Maya: sending first photo: [img: sourdough-crisp.jpg]
Anya: chef emoji :chef:
Sam: snack policing: do not reheat fish in the office oven pls :nauseated_face:
Allison: noted :grimacing:
Maya: last call for toppings — shouting into the void :echo:
Luca: :thumbsup:
All-Hands Bot: Thanks for the vibes, folks. Recording + snack receipts will be posted. :sparkles:
